# Adaptate

> One schema. Each part of the app checks only the fields it uses. A screen, a form, an API client, or a stream.

Paths are relative to the repository root. There is no deployed documentation site.

## Docs

- [Docs](docs/index.md): Where to read about views, streaming, OpenAPI, types, and the generated API.
- [Transform](docs/transform.md): One Zod schema, and a config that marks which fields each screen requires.
- [Streaming](docs/streaming.md): Check a tool call while the JSON is still arriving.
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi.md): Turn an OpenAPI schema into Zod, and write a Zod schema back out.
- [Effect](docs/effect.md): Run the same checks in an Effect pipeline. Effect is an optional peer.
- [TypeScript](docs/typescript.md): Types ship in the npm package. CI checks them on TypeScript 7 and 6.
- [Subpaths](docs/subpaths.md): The published entry points, and which peers each one loads.
- [Optional peers](docs/optional-peers.md): effect, js-yaml, and the ref parser load only when that code is imported.
- [Performance](docs/performance.md): Measured cost of import, a full document, and a streaming check against raw Zod.
- [Proof](docs/proof.md): Each front-page sentence mapped to a test, a script, or a CI job.
- [Migration 2.4](docs/migration-2.4.md): YAML and the ref parser became optional peers between 2.3 and 2.4.
- [Development](docs/development.md): Install, test, and build this repository with pnpm.
